convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'i-CAi' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution. Custom indicator with non-standard smoothing methods requires reimplementation.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total: minimum bars before indicator is valid
TimeShiftSec: timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

derived_values.name: UpSignalTime: timestamp for buy signal expiration
DnSignalTime: timestamp for sell signal expiration

other_exits: Buy close triggered when i-CAi[1] < i-CAi[2] (downtrend detected) and SellPosClose is enabled
Sell close triggered when i-CAi[1] > i-CAi[2] (uptrend detected) and BuyPosClose is enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=deposit fraction based on MM percentage. MM=0.1 interpreted as either 0.1 lots or 0.1% of capital depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal requires two conditions: (1) trend direction from i-CAi[1] vs i-CAi[2] comparison, (2) current value i-CAi[0] must confirm by being >= i-CAi[1] for longs or <= i-CAi[1] for shorts. Signal is evaluated on bar index defined by SignalBar (default=1, previous closed bar). When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated every tick. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that independently control each action. Trade timing uses UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime (current bar open time + timeframe duration) passed to TradeAlgorithms functions, likely implementing 'trade until next bar' expiration logic. GlobalVariableDel_ called on deinit suggests persistent state management.
python_conversion_notes: The i-CAi custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which implements 10+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA). The Applied_price_ enum extends MT5's 7 standard price types with 3 custom ones (Simpl=OC/2, Quarter=HLOC/4, TrendFollow). TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar - all must be reimplemented. The SignalBar=1 default means signals read from the previous closed bar, making this a bar-close strategy suitable for bar-level backtesting. SL=1000 and TP=2000 are in points (not pips), so for 5-digit brokers these are 100/200 pips respectively - digit adjustment is NOT done in this EA, the values are passed directly to trade functions.
